narrative.title: The Cargo Bay Manifest Check
narrative.scenario: A freight loader must prove that some combination of crates in a bay adds up to exactly the customs-declared weight k — no more, no less. Crates are indivisible, and not every declared weight is reachable. The audit bot scans all inclusion patterns and answers a single yes-or-no question for each manifest.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n, an array arr of n non-negative integers, and a target k.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true when some subset of arr sums to exactly k, otherwise false.

hintLevels: Level 1: For each crate the loader decides take it (k shrinks) or leave it (k unchanged).
Level 2: reachable[i][j] = reachable[i-1][j] or (arr[i] <= j and reachable[i-1][j-arr[i]]), with reachable[*][0] = true.
Level 3: A single boolean row sweeps left-to-right per item; watch the arr[i] == 0 case at the boundary.
